We need to propose a retrosynthesis route (max 3 steps) to target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have identified possible building blocks: a para-methyl aniline (p-toluidine) Cc1ccc(N)cc1 (buyable). A sulfonyl chloride: O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccc(C)cc1 (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride) (buyable). An acryloyl amide with an aniline: C=CC(=O)Nc3ccccc3N (maybe not directly buyable but we have building blocks: C=CC(=O)Cl (acryloyl chloride) and aniline (Nc1ccccc1) and also aniline with extra NH2? Actually product has Nc3ccccc3N (para-aminobenzamide). That's an aniline with an amine at para? Wait Nc3ccccc3N is an aniline with an extra amine? Actually it's an aniline (aniline) with an amino group at para? The SMILES Nc3ccccc3N indicates an aniline with an amino substituent at position 1? Actually it's a benzene with two amine substituents at positions 1 and 6? The SMILES "Nc3ccccc3N" is a benzene with two NH2 groups at positions 1 and 6 (para? Actually they are at positions 1 and 6 which are ortho? But anyway it's a diamino benzene (phenylenediamine). That is commercially available? Possibly 1,4-diaminobenzene (p-phenylenediamine) SMILES "Nc1ccc(N)cc1". That's buyable (we saw earlier). So we can use p-phenylenediamine as the amine component.

Thus we can construct the target via two steps:

Step 1: Couple p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride with p-toluidine to form sulfonamide: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C)cc2)cc1 (intermediate A). This is a sulfonamide formation (reaction template: sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide). Need template ID. We can search for sulfonamide formation. Use search with functional_groups_formed sulfonamides and broken acyl chloride? Actually sulfonyl chloride is not acyl chloride but similar. Let's search with functional_groups_formed ["sulfonamides"] and functional_groups_broken ["acyl chloride"] maybe works. Already tried earlier with molecule Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1 and got empty. Maybe need different criteria. Could search without broken.
